entries.sense_note: a call you did not answer

def.micro: a call you did not answer
def.short: a phone call that you did not answer; your phone shows it later
def.long: A phone call that you did not answer, maybe because you were busy or did not hear it. Your phone shows a list of these calls, so you can call back later.

grammar.pattern: have / get a missed call from sb

examples.en: I have three missed calls from my mom.
examples.tr: Annemden üç cevapsız arama var.

examples.en: Sorry, I saw your missed call too late.
examples.tr: Kusura bakma, cevapsız aramanı çok geç gördüm.

examples.en: My phone was in my bag, so I had five missed calls from Kerem.
examples.tr: Telefonum çantamdaydı, Kerem'den beş cevapsız arama vardı.

tr.note: 'Missed' burada 'kaçırılmış' demek. 'I missed your call' (Aramanı kaçırdım) da çok kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: Why didn't you open the phone?
mistakes.right: Why didn't you answer the phone?
mistakes.why: Türkçede gelen aramaya cevap vermeye 'telefonu açmak' denir; 'açmak' 'open' diye çevrilince hata çıkar. İngilizcede aramaya 'answer' ya da 'pick up' denir.

quiz.cloze: I didn't hear my phone ring. Now I have a ______ from Selin.

entries.sense_note: a call where you see each other

def.micro: a talk where you see faces
def.short: a talk on a phone or computer where you can see and hear each other
def.long: A talk on a phone or computer where people can see and hear each other through a camera. People use it to talk with family far away or to have meetings from home.

grammar.pattern: have / make a video call (with sb)

examples.en: Let's have a video call tonight.
examples.tr: Bu akşam görüntülü konuşalım.

examples.en: Grandma loves video calls with her grandchildren.
examples.tr: Büyükannem torunlarıyla görüntülü aramayı çok seviyor.

examples.en: Deniz's camera didn't work, so we couldn't make a video call.
examples.tr: Deniz'in kamerası çalışmadı, o yüzden görüntülü arama yapamadık.

tr.note: Normal sesli aramaya 'voice call' ya da sadece 'call' denir.

quiz.cloze: I want to see your new haircut! Can we have a ______ tonight?

entries.sense_note: recorded spoken message in a chat app

def.micro: spoken note sent in an app
def.short: a short recording of your words that you send to someone in a chat app
def.long: A short recording of your words that you send to someone in a chat app. The other person can listen to it when they have time.

grammar.pattern: send / leave sb a voice message

examples.en: I sent you a voice message.
examples.tr: Sana sesli mesaj gönderdim.

examples.en: Can you listen to my voice message? It's about tomorrow.
examples.tr: Sesli mesajımı dinler misin? Yarınla ilgili.

examples.en: Mira sends voice messages because typing is slow for her.
examples.tr: Mira sesli mesaj gönderiyor, çünkü yazmak ona uzun sürüyor.

quiz.cloze: I'm carrying heavy bags and can't type. I'll send you a ______ instead.

entries.sense_note: a chat with many people in an app

def.short: a place in a messaging app where many people can send messages together
def.long: A place in a messaging app where three or more people send messages to each other. Families, classes and friends often have one.

grammar.pattern: in the group chat; add sb to the group chat

examples.en: I'll share the photos in the group chat.
examples.tr: Fotoğrafları grup sohbetinde paylaşırım.

examples.en: Our family group chat is very busy today.
examples.tr: Aile grubumuzda bugün çok mesaj var.

examples.en: Can you add Lucas to the group chat? He's coming to the party.
examples.tr: Lucas'ı gruba ekler misin? Partiye geliyor.

tr.note: Türkçede çoğu zaman kısaca 'grup' denir: 'gruba attım'. İngilizcede de 'I posted it in the group' denebilir.

quiz.cloze: Our class has a ______. We use it to share homework and news.

entries.sense_note: of a phone: set to make no ring sound

def.micro: set to make no ring sound
def.short: set so that it does not ring or make sounds when a call or message comes
def.long: Set so that it does not ring or make any sound when a call or message comes. People use it in meetings, at the cinema or at night.

grammar.pattern: be / put sth / keep sth on silent

examples.en: Sorry, my phone was on silent.
examples.tr: Kusura bakma, telefonum sessizdeydi.

examples.en: Please put your phones on silent during the film.
examples.tr: Lütfen film sırasında telefonlarınızı sessize alın.

examples.en: I keep my phone on silent at night, so calls don't wake me up.
examples.tr: Aramalar beni uyandırmasın diye geceleri telefonumu sessizde tutuyorum.

tr.note: 'In silent mode' da doğrudur. Titreşimde olmak için 'on vibrate' denir.

quiz.cloze: Nobody heard the phone ring because it was ______.

entries.sense_note: of a call: sound from the loudspeaker

def.short: with the sound coming out loud from the phone so people nearby can hear
def.long: With the sound of a call coming out loud from the phone, so you do not hold it to your ear and people nearby can hear too.

grammar.pattern: put sb / a call on speaker

examples.en: Put me on speaker, please.
examples.tr: Beni hoparlöre al lütfen.

examples.en: I'm cooking, so I'll put you on speaker.
examples.tr: Yemek yapıyorum, o yüzden seni hoparlöre alıyorum.

examples.en: Mom had the call on speaker, so the whole family heard the news.
examples.tr: Annem telefonu hoparlöre almıştı, haberi bütün aile duydu.

tr.note: Türkçede 'hoparlöre almak' denir; İngilizcede 'put someone on speaker' kalıbı kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: My hands are wet. Can you take the call and put it ______?

def.short: write words using a keyboard or the keys on a phone screen
def.long: To write words by pressing keys on a keyboard or on a phone screen. People do this to write messages, emails or searches.

examples.en: I type fast on my phone.
examples.tr: Telefonda hızlı yazıyorum.

examples.en: Type your name in the box.
examples.tr: Adını kutuya yaz.

examples.en: Kaan's screen was cracked, so typing a message took a long time.
examples.tr: Kaan'ın ekranı çatlaktı, bu yüzden mesaj yazmak uzun sürdü.

tr.note: Türkçede ikisi de 'yazmak'. 'Write' kalemle de olur; 'type' yalnızca klavye ya da tuşlarla yazmaktır.

quiz.cloze: The keyboard on this tablet is very small, so I ______ slowly.

entries.sense_note: send on a message you received

def.short: send a message or an email that you got to another person
def.long: To send a message, email or photo that you got from someone to another person. You do not write it again; you send the same one.

grammar.pattern: forward sth to sb / forward sb sth

examples.en: Can you forward me that email?
examples.tr: O e-postayı bana iletebilir misin?

examples.en: I forwarded the photo to the family group chat.
examples.tr: Fotoğrafı aile grubuna ilettim.

examples.en: Please don't forward this message to anyone. It's only for you.
examples.tr: Lütfen bu mesajı kimseye iletme, sadece sana özel.

tr.note: Günlük konuşmada 'forwardlamak' da duyulur. Uygulamalarda düğmenin adı 'İlet' olur.

quiz.cloze: Ali didn't get the invitation, so I ______ him the email that I got.

def.short: turn off the sound of something, like a chat, a video or your microphone
def.long: To turn off the sound of something, like a video, a chat or your microphone in an online meeting. You can turn the sound back on later.

examples.en: I muted the group chat.
examples.tr: Grup sohbetini sessize aldım.

examples.en: Please mute your microphone when you aren't speaking.
examples.tr: Konuşmadığınızda lütfen mikrofonunuzu kapatın.

examples.en: The video was very loud, so Lena muted it on the bus.
examples.tr: Video çok sesliydi, o yüzden Lena otobüste videonun sesini kapattı.

tr.note: Toplantıda sık duyulur: 'You're on mute!' (Sesin kapalı!).

quiz.cloze: We can hear your dog in the meeting. Please ______ your microphone.

def.short: stop a person from calling you, messaging you or seeing your posts online
def.long: To stop a person from calling you, sending you messages or seeing your posts on social media. People do this when someone is rude or annoying.

examples.en: I blocked that number.
examples.tr: O numarayı engelledim.

examples.en: If someone is rude to you online, you can block them.
examples.tr: İnternette biri sana kaba davranırsa onu engelleyebilirsin.

examples.en: Defne blocked her ex on social media, so he can't see her posts.
examples.tr: Defne eski sevgilisini sosyal medyada engelledi; eski sevgilisi artık onun paylaşımlarını göremiyor.

tr.note: Bir kişinin engelini kaldırmak için 'unblock' denir.

quiz.cloze: A stranger keeps sending me rude messages, so I'm going to ______ him.
